restartLoop.name: 5 consecutive restarts through the '重新开始' pause button with trusted clicks, after the decal-counter fix (script t35)
restartLoop.comment: The scene graph stays at 379 objects on every restart, and the heap stays flat at about 70–73 MB. renderer.info geometry and texture counts fluctuate between snapshots (81–100 geometries, 13–32 textures) without growing monotonically; the cause of that fluctuation was not investigated. Snapshots 3–5 were taken a few seconds into play, after new decals had appeared. Before the fix, the decal counter kept accumulating across restarts (8, 16, 24, 32, 40); only the counter was affected, since the decal instances themselves were already hidden.
